**STEP 1 - Scene:** A snack or breakfast tray with two items on separate plates: a toasted grilled cheese sandwich and two slices of dark bread topped with sliced avocado. A cup of milky hot drink sits beside them, but it is not on a plate, so I exclude it.

**STEP 2 - Vessel:** Two white paper plates, each about 20 cm in diameter. Area = 3.14 × 10² ≈ 314 cm² each.

**STEP 3 - Items:**
- Left plate: grilled cheese sandwich (bread with melted cheese)
- Right plate: two slices of dark bread with sliced avocado

**STEP 4 - Area:**
- Grilled cheese: ~30% of its plate (about 90 cm²)
- Dark bread slices: ~15% of the right plate (about 47 cm²)
- Avocado: ~8% of the right plate (about 25 cm²)

**STEP 5 - Volume:**
- Grilled cheese: 90 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 180 ml
- Bread: 47 cm² × 1.5 cm ≈ 70 ml
- Avocado: 25 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 25 ml

**STEP 6 - Grams:**
- Grilled cheese: 180 ml × 0.6 ≈ 110 g (the bulk density is lowered because the sandwich is thinner than its outer envelope and a folded sandwich is not solid)
- Bread: 70 ml × 1.0 ≈ 70 g (about two slices, roughly 35 g each)
- Avocado: 25 ml × 0.7 ≈ 25 g

**STEP 7 - Energy:**
- Grilled cheese: 110 g × 300 kcal/100 g ≈ 330 kcal
- Bread: 70 g × 250 kcal/100 g ≈ 175 kcal
- Avocado: 25 g × 160 kcal/100 g ≈ 40 kcal

**STEP 8 - Sanity check:** Roughly 205 g total and about 545 kcal fits two modest snacks (one sandwich plus two slices of avocado toast). The estimate is plausible for what is visible.

Total: about 205 g, about 545 kcal.
